title: ChatInboxReplyRequest
description: chat.inbox-reply-request@1: what one of an inbox's people sends while working a conversation (chat.inbox.reply). A reply (POST /api/chat/inboxes/:id/conversations/:cid/messages { message }: the conversation becomes open, Vibe stays quiet in it, and the person takes it if nobody has); a status or an assignment (PATCH /:id/conversations/:cid { status: open | resolved | bot, assignee_id: one of the inbox's people | null }); a translation (POST /:id/conversations/:cid/messages/:mid/translate { to } or POST /:id/translate { text, to }). Marking read (POST /:id/conversations/:cid/read) takes no body.
